c.title: $6,200 / 3br - 1500ft2 - New 3 bedrooms 3.5 bathrooms 1/2 Duplex in Kitsilano (Kitsilano)
c.description:
Beautiful newly built duplex completed in 2022, all 3 bedrooms are en-suite.
Excellent location near the West Broadway commercial corridor, with easy access to supermarkets, banks, restaurants, cafes, and various daily conveniences within walking distance.

Steps to West 4th shopping and Kits Beach

Multiple bus routes nearby provide convenient transportation to different areas of the city. The neighborhood is surrounded by elementary and secondary schools, community facilities, and family-friendly amenities.

Equipped with premium North American luxury brand Thermador stove, refrigerator, and dishwasher. All faucets and shower systems throughout the home are fitted with high-end brand （Brizo ）fixtures. The kitchen features a designer-crafted apron-front Blanco sink made from premium materials.
AC and HRV systems.
Radiant floor heating

No garage. Street parking .
Perfect for small families or professionals looking for a modern and convenient home.

Requirements:

• Minimum 1-year lease
• No pets, no smoking
• Tenant insurance required
• Credit reference check and referral letter is required

Appointment for viewing.
